nodes.label: Server-Sent Events Streaming Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Server-Sent Events via /api/stream to push live earthquake and Telegram alert updates to connected clients without polling. The service worker explicitly bypasses /api/ endpoints to avoid hanging streams.

nodes.label: Earthquake Deduplication Strategy
nodes.rationale: Merges duplicate earthquake reports from different agencies when they are within 5 minutes and 50 km. Prefers local agencies (FUNVISIS, CSN, PRSN) for location, depth and magnitude when fusing events.

nodes.label: Web Push Notification Flow
nodes.rationale: Subscribes the browser via PushManager using the VAPID public key from /api/vapidPublicKey, persists the subscription via /api/subscribe, and receives push events through the service worker when new earthquakes are detected.
